task_completion.description: Open the patient fragment, Human MYC reference, and HPV16 reference in the UGENE interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE Project View or sequence tabs show 'patient_tumor_fragment.fasta', 'human_MYC_reference.gb', and 'HPV16_reference.gb' as loaded documents.

task_completion.description: Perform sequence alignment or dot plot analysis to identify human and viral regions.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A Dot Plot window or Alignment Editor window is visible showing a comparison between the patient fragment and the reference genomes.

task_completion.description: Create an annotation named 'Human_DNA' on the patient fragment sequence.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'patient_tumor_fragment' sequence view shows an annotation labeled 'Human_DNA' covering the first portion of the sequence.

task_completion.description: Create an annotation named 'HPV16_DNA' on the patient fragment sequence.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'patient_tumor_fragment' sequence view shows an annotation labeled 'HPV16_DNA' covering the remaining portion of the sequence.

task_completion.description: Export the annotated patient sequence as a GenBank file to the results directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE 'Export as GenBank' dialog is seen, or the file 'patient_annotated.gb' is visible in the file explorer within the results folder.

task_completion.description: Compare the integrated fragment against HPV16 annotations to identify fully contained genes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The HPV16_reference.gb sequence view is open, showing gene annotations (e.g., E6, E7, E1) being compared to the coordinates of the integrated fragment.

task_completion.description: Create a text report with the breakpoint coordinate and the list of preserved HPV genes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal 'cat' command shows 'integration_report.txt' containing a breakpoint coordinate and a comma-separated list of genes.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE graphical interface for analysis rather than just command-line tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, menus, and sequence visualization tools being actively used.

integrity.description: Annotations were created within the UGENE sequence editor, not just written into a text file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The UGENE 'Create Annotation' dialog or the visual representation of annotations on the sequence track is visible.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply output the final report without performing the intermediate alignment steps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory includes screenshots of the dot plot or alignment results used to determine the breakpoint.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The patient_tumor_fragment.fasta is 5500bp long. The human DNA (MYC region) spans 1-2000bp, and the HPV16 DNA spans 2001-5500bp. The breakpoint is at coordinate 2000. The HPV16 segment (3500bp) corresponds to the late region of the HPV16 genome; specifically, it fully contains the L2 and L1 genes. The E1, E2, E4, E5, E6, and E7 genes are either missing or truncated.
